title: The Nixie Shaft
setting: A silver working abandoned when the water came in, half a mile under a hill the local kobolds have been calling theirs for two generations.
tone: close, wet, dark; the good kind of claustrophobic

party.name: Gunnar Volk
party.persona: Worked this shaft before the flood and has opinions about every prop and pit in it. Wants the mine reopened, not cleared — a difference he considers important and nobody else does. Reads the roof constantly. Talks about the mine as if it can hear him, because down here that is only sensible.

party.name: Nell Sixpence
party.persona: Hired as a scout, staying for the silver nobody has counted. Wants to go first, always, and resents being told to wait. Keeps a running estimate of the party's chances aloud, which is not encouraging. Terrified of spiders in a way she covers with volume.

party.name: Sister Vey Kalloran
party.persona: Came for the eleven miners nobody recovered and considers everything else a detour. Wants bodies out before ore. Practical to the point of coldness, tender only at the moment of actual injury. Will spend her last slot on a stranger and let the party argue about it afterwards.

party.name: Thessaly Orn
party.persona: Studying how kobolds organise, which she finds more interesting than the silver and says so at unhelpful moments. Wants to talk to them before anyone stabs them. Light-obsessed: unhappy without a light source, unwise about making one in a place where being seen is the danger.

scenario.opening: The adit still has rails in it, warped where the water reached. Someone has re-timbered the first hundred feet with fresh, wrong-sized props and hung a line of dried-out fish heads across the passage at knee height. Chalk marks on the wall count something in a hand too small to be a miner's.
scenario.location: The flooded silver working under Nixie Hill
objectives: Find out who has re-timbered the shaft
Reach the lower gallery where the miners were lost
Do not drown, and do not fall

scenes.title: The Fish-Head Line
scenes.description: Fresh props, chalk tallies, and a passage narrow enough that going first means going alone.

scenes.title: The Drowned Gallery
scenes.description: Standing water to the knee, silk between the props, and shapes on the roof that are not props.
